project.name: CHB
project.description: Personal, offline-first dashboard for work, finances, goals, health and cross-module statistics.
principles: Cloud synchronization must not silently overwrite conflicts
Daily WorkDay records are the source of truth for work data
Tables are the primary daily work interface
Preferences use the centralized app settings layer
Generated Markdown is output; docs/data JSON is the source of truth
The application must remain usable on older hardware

context.currentGoal: Build the machine-readable documentation foundation, validation, generators and release commands.
lastCompleted: Dashboard weekly goals for 945 PLN and 40 hours

knownIssues.description: Experimental beer comparison may present confusing values and requires a later quality pass.

constraints: Preserve Supabase snapshot and backup compatibility
Do not remove backward-compatible fields without a migration
Keep the application responsive on an older laptop
Do not make generated Markdown the source of truth
